notes.title: Food Truck Empire - Join the Open Playtest!
notes.content:
[h2]To all speer-throwers in vicinity - there’s fresh food to be hunted! 🍔[/h2]
[h3]We’re at PAX West and to celebrate it we’ve opened the playtests for everyone! 🔥[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35532228/48b2234cfda745a36262859eea657712554bdc99.jpg[/img]

If you’re at PAX West yourself - don’t hesitate and come say hello!
[u]We’re located within Expo Hall at Indie Games Polska stall![/u]

PAX West is a great moment to celebrate gaming in its entirety and as a part of those celebrations [b]we’ve opened our Playtest for Food Truck Empire - now with truck customization included[/b]!

[b]It’s THE moment - you can request access to our Open Playtests directly on our FTE Steam Storepage![/b] 

[u]How to do it? It's easy![/u] 
1. Navigate to Food Truck Empire Steam Storepage
2. Scroll down a bit until a green button with "Request access" becomes visible
3. Click on that button! 
4. Wait a short while to receive an access and enjoy your session of Food Truck Empire

⚠️ As we’re still working on our game we’d love to hear back from you and hear your feedback!
You’ll find dedicated in-game buttons that wil allow you to share your feedback with us but you can also reach out to us on [url=discord.gg/QzSMsfPq3y]Discord[/url]! 

🚚 However if you'd rather have a chance to simply watch what we're cooking inside our Food Trucks then instead you can decide to [b]watch our Gameplay Stream today - simply tune in to Food Truck Empire store page to join![/b] 

This will be a great opportunity to see how Food Truck Empire has evolved since the last demo and to check out how the truck customization looks! 🎆

[h3]Have fun everyone and stay wunderbar! ❤️[/h3] 

[h2]💜 Join our Official Discord! 💜[/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/6ZG4cB8frk][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/62d2177277180cfed05fb0ff6c85829a62debd08.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Now available with thunderous drop-in drop-out co-op mode!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow spear-throwers!

A new version of Lichtspeer has been summoned - the Double Speer Edition is now available on Steam!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=522LpnIMumk

[h1]What's new?[/h1]
Thanks to the new co-op mode, you can now explore the ancient germanic future with your friend - [url=http://crunchingkoalas.com/downloads/Lichtspeer/launch/lichtspeerLaunch.html]a space-dog[/url]! It's a drop-in drop-out mode, so feel free to complete the whole campaign as a duo or just have a go for a few minutes to kill some Wurst Zombies and leave your friend to play and die alone.

[h1]I bought the original Lichtspeer - will I get the Double Speer Edition for free?[/h1]
Yes. If for some reason this didn't happen automatically, please let us know in the comments or contact us on [u]publishing@crunchingkoalas.com[/u].

[h1]What about the old version of Lichtspeer?[/h1]
The old version of Lichtspeer has been discontinued - you can still play it if you own it, but you won't be able to buy it anymore.
